dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with negligible curvature; trailing edge follows a straight line from apex to dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification; low pixel radius resulting in a sharp, pointed vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-degree incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curvature with a discrete radius defined by faceted polygonal geometry.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with high thickness relative to length; extends approximately 15% of total cranial length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approx. 135 degrees) at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Monochromatic cyan-teal surface rendering with visible low-polygon mesh artifacts and global luminescent effect.
